Published: 2026-07-06 | Author: One Team Today we're announcing that One has raised $4 mil... / query=enterprise AI transformation production rollout customer deployment / intent=find_original_source / path=capital_startup

announcement Written by One Team Published on Jul 6, 2026 One raises $4M to build the trust layer for AI agents Bringing our total seed funding to $7M to make AI agents safe to deploy inside real enterprises.
Today we're announcing that One has raised $4 million in new seed funding to build a trust layer for AI agents, the system enterprises need to bring the agentic movement into production.
The round brings our total seed funding to $7 million to date.

Our investors, Four Rivers , Ripple Ventures , Golden Ventures , Village Global , and the Hyatt family, share a conviction that the next decade of software will be built by agents, and that agents can't operate inside a business until they can be trusted to act on its behalf.
The problem: agents can reason, but they can't yet be trusted to act AI models have gotten remarkably good at reasoning.

key_excerpts.text: 投资界AI获悉，清华系量子人工智能明星企业清醒异构完成A+轮融资，投资方包括 晶凯资本、安徽高新投、道得投资、励石投资、中咨基金、徐汇资本、森蓝集团、泾东集团创始人 等。
连同此前的A轮，公司在三个月内完成两轮融资，累计金额近亿元。
2021年，清华大学计算机系校友余腾带队创立清醒异构，早期基于经典异构算力的AI系统，如今正完成一次转身——走向量子启发的下一代AI模型前沿，产品进入一系列AI及量子计算产业链。
当前通用量子计算机仍在发展，企业很难等到硬件完全成熟之后才寻找产品。
清醒异构选择让量子启发的高维智能依托现有GPU算力进行大规模推理，围绕从参数到结构的模型重构，解决行业痛点问题，大幅度优化词元TOKEN的使用效率。
放眼通用人工智能时代对算力的需求，这一选择有着足够大的想象空间。
